voltage-violet.$description: Voltage Violet — Primary action buttons, active nav items, key links, brand emphasis — the single chromatic pulse of the interface; everything else defers to it

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Dark section backgrounds, hero canvas, high-contrast text on light surfaces — the midnight counterpart that anchors alternating dark bands

signal-red.$description: Signal Red — Promotional accents, sale/urgency indicators, highlight strokes — used sparingly to flag attention without competing with the primary violet

lilac-whisper.$description: Lilac Whisper — Soft card and container borders — a low-contrast violet edge that brands outlines without adding visual weight

periwinkle-mist.$description: Periwinkle Mist — Cooler card border tone for grouping and container edges — second step in the violet border scale for layered cards

coral-burst.$description: Coral Burst — Error and warning badge fills, alert pills — warm contrast against the cool violet system

aqua-pop.$description: Aqua Pop — Decorative badge backgrounds, hero trust-pill fill — cool cyan that brightens dark sections

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary body and heading text, dominant border color, icon strokes — the near-black that carries all readable content

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary text, muted nav, supporting borders — the mid-gray step between ink and white

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Page and card backgrounds, text on dark surfaces, button fills for ghost variants

frost-blue.$description: Frost Blue — Subtle surface tint for alternating bands, header backgrounds — barely-there cool wash

linen-gray.$description: Linen Gray — Table dividers, hairline borders in data-heavy layouts — a cool neutral that doesn't fight the violet palette

haffer.$description: Single-family system for everything from body to display. Weight 400 carries body, nav, and table text; weight 600 handles headings, buttons, and emphasis. The custom geometric construction gives a contemporary financial-tech voice — rounder apertures than Inter, tighter terminals than Geist.
